title: feat: wallet top-up with saved-card checkout and auto top-up
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Reworks the Pollen page top-up so a returning buyer pays in two taps and turns on auto top-up from the same screen.

- Adds one pack grid with a filled Buy button and an auto top-up switch. With a saved card, Buy opens a modal (Checkout Sessions, `ui_mode: custom`) that leads with the total and one Confirm. Confirm waits for Stripe's currency selector (Stripe's page if it fails), and missing tax details point to completing them on Stripe. Without a saved card, Buy goes to Stripe's hosted page.
- Turning auto top-up on saves at once when a default card and billing details exist. Otherwise the switch opens the Stripe Billing Portal (adding a card deep-links and makes it the default) and the buyer turns auto top-up on after returning, with the chosen pack kept. A missing card or details makes auto top-up unavailable without changing the saved setting; an actual failed charge attempt turns it off.
- Auto top-up problems show under the switch as an icon and the fix (Update card, Approve, Add details); Approve stays visible after switching off. Billing is read-only and badges the card or address concerned (Declined, Incomplete).
- After paying, the page shows "added" only once the webhook credited the session; a bank payment refused after checkout shows as failed with Buy again.
- Adds sm/md/lg sizes to the `@pollinations/ui` Switch.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Repeat purchase | Stripe page, re-enter card | Modal, Confirm |
| Auto top-up, no card | Buy a pack first | Add a card on Stripe, no charge |

Production needs no migration, Tinybird or secret change; the public `STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` is added to the wrangler vars.

Replaces #15837. Validated on staging with the Stripe sandbox.

gist.headline: Two taps to more Pollen
gist.blurb: Returning buyers get a saved-card Confirm instead of another trip through checkout. Auto top-up lives beside the pack grid, with a clear path to add a card without buying a pack first.
gist.summary: The Pollen page adds saved-card checkout through a Stripe custom Checkout Session, an auto top-up switch beside the pack grid, and payment confirmation that waits for the webhook to credit the wallet.
gist.impact: Returning buyers can choose a pack and confirm with their saved card; buyers without one go to Stripe, while auto top-up offers card setup and shows actionable payment issues under its switch.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Pollen wallet as a small garden: a saved card and Confirm button feed a lime-green Pollen flower, while a nearby switch controls a watering can for auto top-up. Polli, wearing a tiny cashier visor, tends the flower; a friendly CRT robot holds the confirmation screen.
